Officer's narrative
On the afternoon of the reported incident in Baytown, Texas, I responded to a two-vehicle collision involving a
low-speed head-on impact. Driver 1 was operating the first vehicle and Driver 2 the second. Driver 1 showed
documentation identifying them as the named insured on the policy for the vehicle involved. Passenger was seated in
the front passenger position of Driver 1's vehicle, and both Driver 1 and Passenger confirmed this at the scene. Driver
1 reported a knee injury and said the knee struck the dashboard during the impact. The injury description is
consistent with the type and force of this collision. Damage to both vehicles is largely consistent with the impact
described by the drivers, and photographs taken at the scene support several of these details. No independent
witnesses were located. Neither driver reported, and I observed no sign of, prior damage to either vehicle. Both
drivers were cooperative, and the vehicles were cleared from the roadway without further incident.
</page>
